Inspected tracked-governance-asset-not-loadable-at-its-path against M1 docs/tests only: Every tracked governance asset resolves to a path its declared consumer can actually load, and no tracked path carries characters that the consumer's own path grammar rejects. A tracked asset its consumer cannot load contributes no enforcement, and its absence must be a machine-detected condition rather than a silent one. Collector-only provider evidence acceptance added; 258 focused tests passed; governance/merge authority unchanged.

Inspected external-precondition-asserted-inside-deterministic-test-lane against M1 docs/tests only: The deterministic validation lane asserts only on repository-owned state. A precondition owned outside the repository -- an Issue body, a remote API response, a live network endpoint -- is validated on the runtime path that actually consumes it and reported as its own attributable signal, never as a deterministic-lane assertion whose failure is indistinguishable from a defect in the change under test.
